protocol.risk_route: local patch top-5% mean distance, label-free global exact quota
protocol.fast_score_route: Fast global anomaly score, exact quota matched to Risk
protocol.uncertainty_route: nearest patch-distance Q90-Q50, exact quota matched to Risk
protocol.random_control: seeded uniform sampling, exact quota matched to Risk

audit_notes: Risk, Random, Fast-score and Uncertainty use identical fallback counts in every row.
Bootstrap CIs operate on paired category-seed rows and are not independent-dataset inference.
